data.name: Mcp.Clients.Intro
data.value: The clients that agents connect to the Management API through. A call through a client is allowed what both the user's roles and the client's role allow.

data.name: Mcp.Clients.ServiceAccounts
data.value: Service accounts come from configuration, so they are neither listed nor changed here. An agent can also reach MCP with a management key.

data.name: Mcp.Clients.Failed
data.value: The clients could not be read.

data.name: Mcp.Clients.None
data.value: No MCP client has registered yet.

data.name: Mcp.Clients.RoleGone
data.value: Its role was deleted, so it reaches nothing

data.name: Mcp.Clients.Approved
data.value: The client {0} is approved with the role {1}.

data.name: Mcp.Clients.RoleChanged
data.value: The client {0} now has the role {1}. Its users sign in through it again.

data.name: Mcp.Clients.Gone
data.value: The client {0} no longer exists: the server removes a client that nobody approved within 7 days, or one the open policy approved that nobody uses. The list is read again.

data.name: Mcp.Clients.Changed
data.value: The client {0} was changed meanwhile, so nothing was done. The list is read again.

data.name: Mcp.Clients.ActionFailed
data.value: The client was not changed. Try again.

data.name: Mcp.Roles.Failed
data.value: The roles could not be read, so no client can be given a role here.

data.name: Mcp.Roles.Help
data.value: A role of every site. It only narrows what the client's users may do with their own roles.

data.name: Mcp.Roles.Unknown
data.value: This role no longer exists. Choose another.

data.name: Mcp.Role.ApproveText
data.value: Approve the client {0} with a role. Its users are then asked for their consent when they sign in through it.

data.name: Mcp.Role.ChangeTitle
data.value: Change the role of the client

data.name: Mcp.Role.ChangeText
data.value: Give the client {0} another role. This ends every token of the client and every user's consent to it, so its users sign in through it again.

data.name: Mcp.Confirm.Reject.Text
data.value: Reject the client {0}? It is refused for good, and the server removes it later.

data.name: Mcp.Confirm.Revoke.Text
data.value: Revoke the client {0}? It is removed with its sessions and tokens, and its access tokens are refused from the next request on.

data.name: Mcp.Register.Intro
data.value: For an agent that does not register itself. The client is approved at once with its role, whatever the registration policy says.

data.name: Mcp.Register.NameHelp
data.value: Shown on the consent page and in the list. Left empty, it is MCP client.

data.name: Mcp.Register.RedirectUrisHelp
data.value: One a line, up to 10: https, or http on localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1].

data.name: Mcp.Register.RedirectUrisRequired
data.value: Enter at least one redirect URI.

data.name: Mcp.Register.Invalid
data.value: The server refused the name or a redirect URI. A redirect URI is https, or http on localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1], with no wildcard, fragment or user information.

data.name: Mcp.Register.Registered
data.value: The client {0} is registered and approved.

data.name: Mcp.Register.Failed
data.value: The client was not registered. Try again.

data.name: Mcp.Registered.Text
data.value: Set the agent up with this client id and one of the redirect URIs. The client is public and has no secret: it signs in with the code flow and PKCE.

data.name: Mcp.Instructions.Intro
data.value: What agents are told in this site. The guidelines go into the handshake of every connection, and the instructions of a content type into the descriptions of its tools. Agents read them as data and never run them.

data.name: Mcp.Instructions.Failed
data.value: The instructions could not be read.

data.name: Mcp.Instructions.Types.None
data.value: No content type has instructions yet.

data.name: Mcp.Instructions.Orphaned
data.value: This type is no longer in the schema, so no agent is served these instructions. Remove them.

data.name: Mcp.Instructions.Add.Heading
data.value: Write instructions for a content type

data.name: Mcp.Instructions.TypesFailed
data.value: The content types could not be read.

data.name: Mcp.Instructions.TextHelp
data.value: Up to 4,000 characters, with line breaks and tabs.

data.name: Mcp.Instructions.TextRequired
data.value: Enter a text, or remove the instructions to have none.

data.name: Mcp.Instructions.Invalid
data.value: A text is up to 4,000 characters, with no control character other than a line break or a tab.

data.name: Mcp.Instructions.TypeGone
data.value: This content type is no longer in the schema.

data.name: Mcp.Instructions.GuidelinesRemoved
data.value: The guidelines of the site are removed.

data.name: Mcp.Prompts.Intro
data.value: The prompts this site offers agents. A prompt is a template whose arguments the agent's user fills in.

data.name: Mcp.Prompts.Failed
data.value: The prompts could not be read.

data.name: Mcp.Prompts.None
data.value: The site has no stored prompt yet.

data.name: Mcp.Prompts.Gone
data.value: The prompt {0} no longer exists. The list is read again.

data.name: Mcp.Prompts.DeleteText
data.value: Delete the prompt {0}? Agents are no longer offered it.

data.name: Mcp.Prompts.DeleteFailed
data.value: The prompt was not deleted. Try again.

data.name: Mcp.Prompt.NameHelp
data.value: 1 to 64 lower case letters, digits, underscores, hyphens and dots, starting with a letter or a digit.

data.name: Mcp.Prompt.NameInvalid
data.value: A name is 1 to 64 lower case letters, digits, underscores, hyphens and dots, starting with a letter or a digit.

data.name: Mcp.Prompt.NameTaken
data.value: Another prompt of the site has this name.

data.name: Mcp.Prompt.NameReserved
data.value: A plugin offers a prompt of this name, so a stored prompt cannot take it.

data.name: Mcp.Prompt.LineInvalid
data.value: The text is too long, or has more than one line.

data.name: Mcp.Prompt.ArgumentNameHelp
data.value: 1 to 64 letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter or an underscore.

data.name: Mcp.Prompt.ArgumentNameInvalid
data.value: An argument has a name of 1 to 64 letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter or an underscore, which no other argument has.

data.name: Mcp.Prompt.TemplateHelp
data.value: Up to 16,000 characters. Write an argument as {{name}}.

data.name: Mcp.Prompt.TemplateInvalid
data.value: The template has a control character other than a line break or a tab, or {{ where no argument follows.

data.name: Mcp.Prompt.UndeclaredArgument
data.value: The template names an argument that the prompt does not declare.

data.name: Mcp.Prompt.TooMany
data.value: The site has as many stored prompts as it may, or the prompt has too many arguments.

data.name: Mcp.Prompt.Failed
data.value: The prompt was not saved. Try again.

data.name: Mcp.Activity.Intro
data.value: What agents did in this site through MCP, newest first.

data.name: Mcp.Activity.Failed
data.value: The agent writes could not be read.

data.name: Mcp.Activity.None
data.value: No agent has written anything in this site.
